<?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// Keepsoft demo seed - ProfitLens. A small coffee-gear store, 10 orders over 30 days, costs, fees and ad spend.
add_filter('pre_wp_mail','__return_true'); global $wpdb;
update_option('woocommerce_calc_taxes','yes'); update_option('woocommerce_prices_include_tax','no'); update_option('woocommerce_tax_based_on','billing');
$wpdb->query("DELETE FROM {$wpdb->prefix}woocommerce_tax_rates");
WC_Tax::_insert_tax_rate(['tax_rate_country'=>'AU','tax_rate'=>'10.0000','tax_rate_name'=>'GST','tax_rate_priority'=>1,'tax_rate_compound'=>0,'tax_rate_shipping'=>1,'tax_rate_order'=>1,'tax_rate_class'=>'']);
update_option('pl_gateway_fees',['stripe'=>['percent'=>1.75,'fixed'=>0.30],'paypal'=>['percent'=>2.6,'fixed'=>0.30]]);
update_option('pl_shipping_costs',['flat_rate'=>9.5,'free_shipping'=>8]); update_option('pl_packaging_cost','1.2'); update_option('pl_default_margin','45'); update_option('pl_shipping_fallback','income');
$cats=[]; foreach(['Coffee Gear','Homewares','Gifts'] as $c){$t=wp_insert_term($c,'product_cat'); $cats[$c]=is_wp_error($t)?get_term_by('name',$c,'product_cat')->term_id:$t['term_id'];}
$defs=[['Ceramic Pour-Over Dripper',49,18,'Coffee Gear'],['Gooseneck Kettle 1L',89,36,'Coffee Gear'],['Burr Hand Grinder',129,52,'Coffee Gear'],['Espresso Tamper Set',45,14,'Coffee Gear'],['Linen Tea Towel 3-Pack',34,9,'Homewares'],['Stoneware Mug Set of 4',68,31,'Homewares'],['Marble Serving Board',79,38,'Homewares'],['Beeswax Candle Trio',39,12,'Gifts'],['Barista Gift Hamper',95,102,'Gifts'],['Pour-Over Starter Kit',119,null,'Coffee Gear']];
$P=[]; foreach($defs as $i=>[$n,$pr,$co,$c]){$p=new WC_Product_Simple();$p->set_name($n);$p->set_sku('KC-'.(100+$i));$p->set_regular_price($pr);$p->set_status('publish');$p->set_category_ids([$cats[$c]]);$id=$p->save(); if($co!==null) update_post_meta($id,'_pl_cost',$co); $P[]=wc_get_product($id);}
foreach([['WELCOME10',10],['EOFY15',15]] as [$code,$amt]){$c=new WC_Coupon();$c->set_code($code);$c->set_discount_type('percent');$c->set_amount($amt);$c->save();}
$names=[['Emily','Hartley','Fitzroy','3065'],['Noah','Bennett','Richmond','3121'],['Chloe','Nguyen','Footscray','3011'],['Lachlan','Murray','Geelong','3220'],['Isla','Campbell','Brunswick','3056'],['Jack','Dimitriou','Preston','3072'],['Ruby','Anderson','St Kilda','3182'],['Oliver','Tan','Docklands','3008'],['Matilda','Reid','Ballarat','3350'],['Harrison','Cole','Hawthorn','3122'],['Georgia','Sinclair','Williamstown','3016'],['Max','Pavlovic','Sunshine','3020']];
$intl=[['US','Austin'],['NZ','Auckland'],['GB','Leeds'],['NZ','Wellington']];
// 10 orders over 30 days (kept small so the demo boots fast): day, customer, [product index, qty]..., AU?, coupon, gateway, status
$plan=[[29,0,[[0,1],[3,1]],1,'','stripe','completed'],[26,1,[[2,1]],1,'WELCOME10','paypal','completed'],[22,2,[[8,1]],1,'','stripe','completed'],[19,3,[[1,1],[7,2]],1,'','paypal','completed'],[16,4,[[5,1]],0,'','stripe','completed'],[13,5,[[6,1],[4,1]],1,'','stripe','completed'],[10,6,[[9,1]],1,'EOFY15','paypal','completed'],[7,7,[[2,1],[3,1]],1,'','stripe','completed'],[4,8,[[8,1],[0,1]],1,'','stripe','completed'],[1,9,[[1,1],[5,1]],1,'','paypal','processing']];
$ords=[];
foreach($plan as [$d,$ni,$lines,$au,$coupon,$gw,$st]){ $nm=$names[$ni]; $ic=$intl[$ni%4];
  $o=wc_create_order(['status'=>'pending']); $addr=['first_name'=>$nm[0],'last_name'=>$nm[1],'email'=>strtolower($nm[0].'.'.$nm[1]).'@gmail.com','country'=>$au?'AU':$ic[0],'state'=>$au?'VIC':'','postcode'=>$au?$nm[3]:'1010','city'=>$au?$nm[2]:$ic[1],'address_1'=>(10+$ni*7).' High Street'];
  $o->set_address($addr,'billing');$o->set_address($addr,'shipping');
  foreach($lines as [$pi,$q]) $o->add_product($P[$pi],$q);
  if($coupon)$o->apply_coupon($coupon);
  $s=new WC_Order_Item_Shipping(); $s->set_method_title($au?'Flat rate':'International'); $s->set_method_id('flat_rate'); $s->set_total($au?9.5:24); $o->add_item($s);
  $o->set_payment_method($gw); $o->set_date_created(gmdate('Y-m-d',time()-$d*86400).' '.sprintf('%02d:%02d:00',9+$ni,($ni*13)%60)); $o->calculate_totals(true);
  $o->set_status($st); $o->save(); $ords[]=$o; }
// One refund (a partial refund of one line on order 6)
foreach([5] as $ri){ $o=$ords[$ri]; $it=array_values($o->get_items())[0]; $tx=$it->get_taxes(); $t=array_sum($tx['total']); $amt=(float)$it->get_total()/$it->get_quantity();
  wc_create_refund(['order_id'=>$o->get_id(),'amount'=>round($amt+$t/$it->get_quantity(),2),'line_items'=>[$it->get_id()=>['qty'=>1,'refund_total'=>$amt,'refund_tax'=>[]]],'refund_payment'=>false,'restock_items'=>false]); }
mt_srand(11);
$exp=ProfitLens_Install::table('expenses');
for($d=59;$d>=0;$d--){ $day=gmdate('Y-m-d',time()-$d*86400); $wpdb->insert($exp,['date_start'=>$day,'date_end'=>$day,'kind'=>'ad','source'=>'meta','campaign'=>'Always-on retargeting','amount'=>mt_rand(500,1100)/100,'note'=>'','created_at'=>gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s')]); if($d%2==0)$wpdb->insert($exp,['date_start'=>$day,'date_end'=>$day,'kind'=>'ad','source'=>'google','campaign'=>'Shopping - Coffee Gear','amount'=>mt_rand(400,900)/100,'note'=>'','created_at'=>gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s')]); }
$rec=ProfitLens_Install::table('recurring');
foreach([['Shopify plan',79,'monthly'],['Warehouse rent',60,'weekly'],['Klaviyo',45,'monthly']] as $r){ $wpdb->insert($rec,['name'=>$r[0],'amount'=>$r[1],'period'=>$r[2],'date_start'=>gmdate('Y-m-01',time()-70*86400),'date_end'=>null,'active'=>1]); }
ProfitLens_Engine::process_queue();
update_option('permalink_structure','/%postname%/'); flush_rewrite_rules();
